findings.title: Broken Product URL Slug
findings.description: Four Leaf Clover Pendant is indexed at /store-2/p/milk-dip-cup-92wf6-3epst. The slug 'milk-dip-cup-92wf6-3epst' has zero semantic relationship to the product. Google uses URL slugs as a strong keyword relevance signal. This page cannot rank for any jewellery-related query.
findings.recommendation: Rename the product URL in Squarespace to /shop/p/four-leaf-clover-pendant. Set up a permanent 301 redirect from the old /store-2/ URL to the new URL immediately.

findings.title: Duplicate /store-2/ Store Path Contaminating Index
findings.description: Two products appear at /store-2/p/ path, including an 'Earth & Sky Planter' — a physical planter, not jewellery. Google is indexing these pages, diluting crawl budget and creating topical confusion for a diamond jewellery brand.
findings.recommendation: Delete legacy /store-2/ products entirely from Squarespace. If they must stay, add <meta name='robots' content='noindex'> to all /store-2/ pages via Squarespace per-page SEO settings.

findings.title: Non-www → www Redirect Not Verified
findings.description: User entered anjain.in (non-www) but all indexed pages resolve to www.anjain.in. Without a confirmed 301 redirect, Google may treat these as separate domains, splitting link equity and potentially causing duplicate indexation.
findings.recommendation: Test curl -I https://anjain.in and confirm HTTP 301 redirects to https://www.anjain.in. If not, configure in Squarespace Domains settings.

findings.title: Only 9 Pages Indexed
findings.description: site:anjain.in shows only ~9 pages in Google's index. For an e-commerce jewellery store with multiple product categories and a blog, this is severely under-indexed. Google may not be discovering all product pages.
findings.recommendation: Verify XML sitemap is submitted in GSC and lists all product and blog pages. Check for orphan pages (no internal links pointing to them). Use GSC URL Inspection to identify indexation issues.

findings.title: No Google Search Console Confirmed
findings.description: No GSC credentials configured. Without GSC, there is no visibility into crawl errors, indexation status, keyword impressions, or Core Web Vitals field data.
findings.recommendation: Set up GSC: verify domain ownership via DNS TXT record. Submit sitemap. Connect to Analytics 4.

findings.title: Security Headers Unknown
findings.description: Could not verify HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, or X-Content-Type-Options headers due to network access restriction. Squarespace provides basic security but custom headers may be missing.
findings.recommendation: Verify security headers via securityheaders.com. Squarespace does not support custom header injection without a Business plan or higher.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Founder-authored blog establishes personal E-E-A-T (Atishay Jain, Nishaant Jain)
/ourstory page exists — brand narrative and sustainability angle present
Lab grown diamond + recycled gold positioning is a genuine differentiator
Named product pieces (Mia, Harmony, Cleopatra, Chakra, Samantha) suggest attention to product storytelling

findings.title: Blog Stale Since February 2023
findings.description: Last blog post dated February 2023 — 16+ months of no content updates. Google's QRG explicitly rewards sites that demonstrate ongoing expertise and freshness. Stale content signals reduced editorial investment to both Google and prospective buyers.
findings.recommendation: Restart blog with minimum 3 posts/month. Priority topics: 'lab grown diamonds vs natural diamonds india', '14K recycled gold jewellery explained', 'CVD vs HPHT diamonds', 'how to buy lab grown diamond rings in India'. Target long-tail informational queries.

findings.title: Zero Brand Visibility in Category Listicles
findings.description: Multiple 'Top 10 Lab Grown Diamond Brands India 2026' articles rank on page 1 of Google. A.N. JAIN appears in none of them. These listicles drive high-intent brand discovery traffic and represent the most efficient external editorial E-E-A-T signal.
findings.recommendation: Identify the 8 top-ranking 'best lab grown diamond' articles. Contact each author with brand story, founder expertise, sustainability angle (lab grown + recycled gold), and product images. Aim for 3+ editorial mentions within 60 days.

findings.title: Product Descriptions Likely Thin
findings.description: Named products (Mia, Harmony, Cleopatra, Chakra) suggest branded descriptions exist, but Squarespace product pages typically have limited word count. E-commerce product pages need substantive descriptions to compete for long-tail keywords.
findings.recommendation: Each product page should have: 150+ words of unique description, diamond specifications (color grade, clarity, carat), gold details (14K, recycled, BIS hallmark), care instructions, and sizing guidance.

findings.title: E-E-A-T Signals on Product Pages Not Confirmed
findings.description: For high-consideration purchases like diamond jewellery, Google's QRG places heavy weight on E-E-A-T signals: expertise indicators, certification mentions, author attribution, and trust markers.
findings.recommendation: Add to each product page: IGI/BIS certification badge, gemstone grading specifics (E-H colour, VVS-VS clarity), and a founder trust statement. Add reviews widget (Trustpilot or Google Reviews embed).

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Product pages have individual URLs (not pagination-based)
Named product slugs (/shop/p/samantha, /shop/p/mia) are mostly clean
Brand name 'A.N. JAIN' consistent in page titles

findings.title: Title and Meta Description Quality Not Verified
findings.description: Could not directly inspect page titles and meta descriptions. Squarespace auto-generates these from product names and descriptions, which often produces generic, non-keyword-optimised titles.
findings.recommendation: Audit titles via GSC or Screaming Frog. Optimal pattern: '[Product Name] | Lab Grown Diamond [Type] | A.N. JAIN'. Homepage title should target 'lab grown diamond jewellery india'. All meta descriptions should be under 155 chars with primary keyword in first 20 words.

findings.title: Internal Linking Between Blog and Products
findings.description: Blog articles (if they exist on target keywords) should link to relevant product pages to pass topical authority. This is a standard e-commerce SEO practice that Squarespace blogs typically don't automate.
findings.recommendation: Add 2–3 contextual internal links per blog post to relevant product pages. Example: blog post on 'CVD diamonds' links to specific ring or pendant products.

findings.title: Heading Structure Unknown
findings.description: Could not verify H1/H2/H3 structure on product or category pages. Squarespace themes sometimes place product names in H1 but skip semantic heading hierarchy on category/collection pages.
findings.recommendation: Verify each page has exactly one H1 (the product/category name with primary keyword). H2s should cover key attributes: material, gemstone specifications, certification, care.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Squarespace auto-generates basic Product schema on shop pages
Basic Organization schema likely present via Squarespace

findings.title: Product Schema Incomplete
findings.description: Squarespace's auto-generated Product schema typically omits: aggregateRating, material, gemstone properties (color, clarity, cut, carat), brand entity, offers.availability, and itemCondition. For Google Shopping eligibility and rich results, these fields are required.
findings.recommendation: Inject custom JSON-LD via Squarespace code injection (Settings → Advanced → Code Injection → Footer). Add: aggregateRating (once reviews collected), material ('14K Recycled Gold'), gemstone color/clarity/cut, brand (A.N. JAIN entity), availability (InStock or MadeToOrder).

findings.title: No AggregateRating Schema
findings.description: No customer review data in schema markup means no star ratings in search results. Star ratings increase click-through rates by 15–30% for product pages.
findings.recommendation: Integrate a reviews platform (Trustpilot, Stamped.io, or Google Reviews). Once reviews are collected, inject AggregateRating schema referencing live review data.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList Schema
findings.description: Breadcrumb structured data helps Google understand site hierarchy and enables breadcrumb rich results in SERPs. Squarespace does not auto-generate BreadcrumbList schema.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD: Home > Shop > Pendants/Rings > [Product Name].

findings.title: FAQPage Schema — Informational Only
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on May 7, 2026. FAQPage schema no longer produces SERP features. It still has value for AI/LLM citations but should not be built for Google SERP benefit.
findings.recommendation: If adding FAQ content to product pages, use QAPage schema for genuine Q&A. Do not invest in FAQPage for Google SERP benefit.

findings.title: Core Web Vitals — No Field Data Available
findings.description: No CrUX data available (requires Google API key + sufficient traffic). Squarespace jewellery sites with high-resolution product photography historically score Needs Improvement or Poor on LCP. Expected lab estimates: LCP 3–5s, INP moderate, CLS low-medium.
findings.recommendation: Connect Google API key (run /seo google setup) to get real CrUX field data. In the meantime, run PageSpeed Insights manually at pagespeed.web.dev. Target: LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1.

findings.title: High-Resolution Product Images Likely Unoptimised
findings.description: Jewellery product photography is typically 3–8MB raw. Squarespace resizes images but does not always serve WebP or apply aggressive compression. Large images are the leading cause of poor LCP on Squarespace.
findings.recommendation: Upload images at maximum 2000px wide and pre-compressed to under 500KB. Use WebP format. Squarespace will serve responsive variants, but starting with optimised source images reduces LCP significantly.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: AI crawlers NOT blocked (confirmed via Squarespace crawler settings screenshot — both boxes unchecked)

findings.title: Zero AI Overview Citations
findings.description: A.N. JAIN does not appear in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, or Perplexity results for 'lab grown diamond jewellery india' or related queries. Despite AI crawlers being allowed, the site lacks content depth and brand authority for AI systems to cite it.
findings.recommendation: Publish 3+ long-form educational articles (1500+ words) on lab grown diamond topics. Add structured passage-level content (clear H2 sections, concise answers to specific questions) to improve citability.

findings.title: No llms.txt File
findings.description: No /llms.txt file present to guide AI crawlers on brand, key pages, and content structure. While not yet a ranking factor, llms.txt is emerging best practice for AI search visibility in 2026.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt at www.anjain.in/llms.txt with brand description, key pages, and structured content inventory.

findings.title: Brand Mention Signals Insufficient
findings.description: AI systems cite brands they have seen referenced across multiple authoritative sources. A.N. JAIN has minimal third-party mentions (estimated <5 editorial references).
findings.recommendation: Prioritise PR outreach to jewellery/sustainability publications. Even 3–5 editorial mentions in domain-relevant publications significantly improves AI citation probability.

categories.name: Images

findings.title: Alt Text Not Verified
findings.description: Could not audit alt text on product images. Squarespace uses product names as alt text by default, which is often generic ('Mia' rather than 'Mia pendant lab grown diamond 14K recycled gold').
findings.recommendation: Override default alt text for all product images with descriptive, keyword-rich alternatives. Format: '[Product Name] [product type] lab grown diamond 14K recycled gold India'. This improves both image search rankings and accessibility.

findings.title: Open Graph Images Per Product Not Confirmed
findings.description: For a jewellery brand where Instagram and Pinterest are primary discovery channels, custom OG images on every product page are critical for social sharing CTR. Squarespace may generate generic OG images.
findings.recommendation: Upload a custom OG image (1200x630px) for each product page in Squarespace's per-page SEO settings. Use high-contrast product photography on a white or brand-coloured background.
